messages:
maria: quick heads-up — we're discussing changing how SDKs emit quota routing headers. idea: make the new header behavior opt-in via a flag (so v1.5 SDKs don't break existing clients). want feedback especially from Go/TS SDK folks and console team.

jake: curious — what's the user value? is this to align with console quota buckets? :thinking_face:

maria: yes. right now clients set free-form `X-Redwood-Quota` and console heuristics try to map that to quota buckets. result: noisy dashboards and wrong cost attributions. if SDKs emit a structured header (or opt-in mapping) we can surface sane defaults in the console and attach telemetry keys for stable attribution.

tara: from SDK angle: Go has enums for route tags and a strong type surface. changing header shape could be breaking for apps that inspect raw headers in middleware. opt-in feels safer.

samir: console POV: if we get a stable header shape like `X-Redwood-Quota: bucket=<env:team:project>;meta=...` we can reliably map to the quota dashboard and provide per-bucket cost trends. but we need a migration window and a toggle in the console that shows "mapped vs inferred" attribution for 30d.

leo: +1 on toggle. also we need telemetry fields so we can A/B compare cost/latency when opt-in is enabled. otherwise we'll just guess.

maria: thoughts on UX for rollout: package-level opt-in flag + env var + server-side feature-flag gating? propose: default false; enable via `RedwoodQuotaOptIn=true` env var or SDK config. then send a telemetry event: { "quota_optin": true, "sdk": "python", "sdk_version": "1.5.0" }.

tara: code sketch (python) — opt-in as config:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=..., quota_opt_in=True)
# results in header: X-Redwood-Quota: v2;bucket=team:payments;source=sdk
```

jake: go sketch — preserve old header unless optin set:
```go
cli := redwood.NewClient(opts...)
cli.SetQuotaOptIn(true)
// middleware will emit: X-Redwood-Quota-V2: bucket=team:payments;sdk=go
```

samir: one risk: internal proxies and api-gw that already rely on `X-Redwood-Quota` string matching. we should add compatibility shim in api-gw that maps v2 -> inferred v1 header for a transition period. build-bot can open a PR to add shim with a 90-day TTL.

build-bot: CI check passed for api-gw shim branch `feat/quota-header-shim` — PR #4827 created.

leo: telemetry detail: include `quota_mapping_version` and `optin_source` (env|sdk|console) on requests. that avoids confusion when multiple mechanisms are used.

tara: small ask — SDKs should document middleware breakage and provide a helper to translate legacy header checks to new shape. add an FAQ: "How to detect quota header in middleware" with examples for express, gin, and uvicorn.

jake: ops concern: rolling out opt-in across hosted customers might cause sudden changes in quota metering. recommend gating by customer segment: start with internal + a few opt-in customers, then enable platform-wide after 30d QA. also add a console banner when mapping flips.

maria: agree. proposed rollout plan: 1) land SDK opt-in config + docs; 2) deploy api-gw shim; 3) enable opt-in for internal + staging teams; 4) collect telemetry for 30d and run regression checks on cost attribution and latency; 5) flip console mapping toggle for pilot customers; 6) announce broader rollout 60d out.

samir: will add a console tile to show "quota mapping health" (mismatched attributions count, recent flips).

tara: timeline feasibility: can ship SDK changes in next minor (python 1.5, go 0.9, ts 2.2) if we freeze the header format this week. otherwise it'll slip.

maria: decision: freeze header format draft today. tara & jake will finalize SDK opts and add telemetry event schema. samir & leo will spec console flags and dashboard tile. build-bot will coordinate PRs and link them in this thread.

leo: :thumbsup: I'll draft the telemetry schema and post here by EOD.

tara: I'll add the middleware compatibility helper and a doc patch. ETA Wed.

jake: I'll open the SDK opt-in PRs and add deprecation notes for the next major.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups: build-bot to post PR links; samir to add console mockups; leo to add telemetry draft. ping if blocked.

build-bot: created tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/1392 (quota-header-optin-rollout).
